notes: NWC definition used here is simplified as Total current assets minus Total current liabilities (no bespoke exclusion of cash/debt). This is internally consistent across all historical years and can be replaced if the pipeline uses a different convention. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

D&A uses the cash-flow components (Depreciation + Amortization of acquired intangible assets). Capex uses the cash-flow line 'Capital expenditures' and excludes 'Increase in equipment under customer usage agreements' to avoid mixing operating vs financing/contract economics. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

WACC (0.085) and NOL utilization percent are not explicitly disclosed in the collected filings for modeling granularity; tax rate is set from FY2025 effective rate. Replace WACC and NOL utilization with model-specific inputs if available. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

Comps EV/NTM Revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, and P/E NTM were left null because NTM EV-based multiples were not reliably retrievable from free primary sources within this run; peers are listed for model wiring.

catalysts: Merger process milestones (stockholder vote, regulatory approvals) and deal closing in the first half of calendar 2026. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

Achievement of Breast Health revenue metrics tied to the non-tradable contingent value right (CVR) for FY2026/FY2027. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))
company_overview: Hologic develops and supplies premium diagnostics products, medical imaging systems, and surgical products, organized into four segments: Diagnostics, Breast Health, GYN Surgical, and Skeletal Health. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))
Fiscal 2025 revenue was $4,100.5 million with income from operations (EBIT) of $714.3 million. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

The company is under a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by affiliates of Blackstone and TPG, with closing expected in the first half of calendar 2026 (subject to approvals). ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))
current_context: Q1 fiscal 2026 revenue was $1,047.8 million (+2.5%), with GAAP operating margin of 22.6% (GAAP income from operations of $237.0 million). ([investors.hologic.com](https://investors.hologic.com/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/Hologic-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-of-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))

Hologic stated it will not provide annual or quarterly financial guidance for fiscal 2026 due to the pending acquisition. ([investors.hologic.com](https://investors.hologic.com/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/Hologic-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-of-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))

Liquidity remained strong: cash and cash equivalents were $2.17 billion, and adjusted net leverage ratio (net debt / adjusted EBITDA) was 0.3x; short-term investments were $197 million. ([investors.hologic.com](https://investors.hologic.com/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/Hologic-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-of-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Base-case top-line growth is modest (mid-single-digit transitioning to low-single-digit), anchored to the company’s recent low-growth revenue profile (FY2024 ~flat to FY2025 +1.8%). ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

Base-case EBIT margin is stabilized with gradual improvement from the FY2025 operating income level, reflecting the expectation of ongoing cost discipline despite prior year volatility from restructuring/impairments. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

Capital intensity assumptions use the company’s historical cash capital expenditures trend (capex as % of sales declining versus FY2023). ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

Working capital intensity is modeled using a consistent, balance-sheet-based NWC % of sales framework to avoid ad hoc normalization. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))
key_risks: Post-deal integration and execution risk: disruption or cost actions may pressure margins and working capital. ([investors.hologic.com](https://investors.hologic.com/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/Hologic-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-of-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))

Operating volatility from restructuring and impairment charges (FY2025 included significant impairment-related items), which can make normalization difficult. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

Macro/FX/tariff and other cost headwinds (Q1 fiscal 2026 cited tariff expenses as a factor in margin movement). ([investors.hologic.com](https://investors.hologic.com/press-releases/press-release-details/2026/Hologic-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-of-Fiscal-2026/default.aspx))

valuation_summary: DCF drivers are constructed from GAAP historicals (revenue, operating income, depreciation & amortization components, and cash capex) with forecast ratios expressed as % of sales for QA controllability. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))

Terminal value is based on a Gordon-growth terminal approach (gordon_growth) with conservative long-run growth to reflect a mature med-tech profile and acquisition-related uncertainty. ([s29.q4cdn.com](https://s29.q4cdn.com/816090369/files/doc_financials/2025/ar/FY25-10-K.pdf))
